capabilities: Find notes similar to the active note and show them in a sidebar
Create links between notes from the suggestions
Index the vault with bloom filters and n-gram analysis
Rebuild or clear the index from settings
Tune maximum suggestions and enable debug mode
extras: Troubleshooting section reports freezes and index corruption in large vaults (5,000+ notes) and gives cache-deletion recovery steps; documents performance limits like sampling for vaults over 10,000 notes.
problem: Obsidian only surfaces connections you have already made; there is no built-in way to discover notes that are textually similar but not linked.
summary: Suggests notes related to the active note using bloom filter similarity analysis and lets you create links to them from a sidebar.
